name: What Is Sexual Immorality
overview: Sexual immorality, as revealed in Scripture, violates God's design for marriage and purity. Genesis 2:24 establishes the sacred union of one man and one woman becoming one flesh, while Jesus in Matthew 5:28 teaches that even lustful intent is sinful adultery of the heart. Colossians 3:5 calls believers to put to death sinful desires including fornication and uncleanness, and Hebrews 13:4 affirms that marriage is honorable and undefiled, warning that God will judge adulterers and immoral persons. The consequences of sexual sin are severe, as illustrated by Revelation 14:8's depiction of judgment on those who lead nations into fornication, yet James 5:16 encourages confession and prayer as means of healing and restoration.
